create_BoundVars: create a BoundVars instance to perform value range analysis on a LoopBody's fx graph
run_get_bounds: run get_bounds on a BoundVars instance to return value ranges for each node in the loop graph
swap_submodules: swap submodules in a BoundVars instance to replace get_index, masked_subblock, and set_indirect handlers
test_masked_subblock: test the masked_subblock method to compute value ranges within a masked subblock graph
review_get_index: review the get_index method to compute and cache sympy expression bounds for loop indexing variables
